defects.old_behavior: complex_jones_channel.py:104 applies the component Jones to the canonical RX r_canonical that ALREADY contains AWGN: r_out = J_b @ r_canonical. Oracle/B3 then invert J, which simultaneously undoes the noise transform, so the PDL 0->9.5 dB impaired realizations are bit-identical after inversion (a construction identity, not a physical null result).
defects.expected_semantics: Separate clean_original = sqrt(h) R(theta) @ s from the canonical realization; n_post = r_canonical - clean_original; apply the component operator to the CLEAN signal only and ADD the same n_post. The component must never touch n_post.
defects.source_line: complex_jones_channel.py:104 (r_out = J_b @ r_canonical); legacy result.json M2 BER ratio 2.0282 identical across PDL 0/3.5/6/9.5 dB
defects.fix: semantic_channel.separate_canonical + build_impaired_realization (component op on clean_component + n_post)

defects.old_behavior: complex_jones_channel.py:142 uses g=[cond,1] so the max singular value = cond > 1, i.e. the 'PDL component' amplifies. A real passive component cannot amplify.
defects.expected_semantics: Passive PDL: singular values = [1, 10^(-PDL_dB/20)]; sigma_max=1, cond=10^(PDL_dB/20). Max transmissivity <= 1.
